facts.text: I have a cat named Luna.
Luna loves to play with a laser pointer toy.
One of Luna's favorite scratching posts is a tall sisal rope scratching post.
The tall sisal rope scratching post was getting worn out a few days ago.
I want to get Luna more scratching posts and pads.
I am considering placing scratching posts and pads near windows so Luna can look outside while scratching.
I am thinking of setting up a little photo studio in my living room to take more pictures of Luna.
I have fun props and a nice background for photographing Luna.
I have noticed Luna loves to pose on her tall sisal rope scratching post.
I want to incorporate the tall sisal rope scratching post into a photo shoot.
I am thinking of using a simple background and Luna's favorite toys as props for photos.
I am thinking of using the laser pointer toy and the tall sisal rope scratching post as photo props.
Sometimes I feel like Luna is looking right past me instead of directly at the camera.
I am thinking about switching Luna's food to a new brand that is supposed to be better for her digestive health.
I want tips on how to transition Luna to the new food gradually.
